name: Silodosin US pivotal trials
question: Does silodosin improve lower urinary tract symptoms more than placebo in men with symptomatic BPH?

design.population: Men aged 50 years or older with IPSS at least 13, peak urinary flow of 4–15 mL/s, and postvoid residual less than 250 mL; a 4-week placebo run-in excluded those with at least a 30% IPSS decrease or a flow increase of at least 3 mL/s.
design.description: Pooled, multicenter, double-blind phase 3 randomized trials
design.locator: Full text, Patients and Study Design and Figure 1, pp 2635–2636

verdictNote: Week-12 IPSS improved more with silodosin; retrograde ejaculation was more frequent.
takeaway: Across two randomized US phase 3 trials, silodosin 8 mg daily improved week-12 IPSS more than placebo (−6.4 vs −3.5 points; adjusted difference −2.8, 95% CI −3.6 to −2.0); retrograde ejaculation occurred in 131/466 versus 4/457 men.

reports.followUpLocator: Full text, Patients and Study Design, p 2635
